hero.title: Word to Markdown
hero.subtitle: Upload a Word document and convert it to Markdown in one click

steps: Click the upload button above or drop your .docx file into the upload area
The Word document is parsed and converted to Markdown automatically
When the conversion is done, copy the result or download it as a .md file
notes: ⚠️ Complex tables may need manual adjustments

dualPreview.title: Dual-Mode Preview
dualPreview.desc: View the raw HTML code or the rendered page result

completeDoc.title: Complete Document
completeDoc.desc: The downloaded HTML file includes full styles and document structure

hero.title: HTML to Markdown
hero.subtitle: Convert HTML code into clean Markdown format, with live preview

smartClean.title: Smart Cleanup
smartClean.desc: Automatically removes styles, scripts, and comments from HTML, extracting pure text content

fullSupport.title: Full Support
fullSupport.desc: Supports headings, lists, tables, code blocks, links, and other common HTML elements

download.title: One-Click Download
download.desc: Copy the result directly or download it as a .md file after conversion

traits: 🔧 Removes script and style tags automatically

hero.title: Markdown to PDF
hero.subtitle: Convert Markdown documents into high-quality PDF files, with live preview

quality.title: High-Quality Output
quality.desc: A professional rendering engine produces clean, well-formatted PDF documents

preview.title: Live Preview
preview.desc: See the rendered result while you type, so the output always matches your expectations

download.title: One-Click Download
download.desc: Download the generated PDF with a single click — no waiting

notes: ⚠️ PDF generation may take a few seconds — please be patient
⚠️ Complex tables and code blocks may need manual formatting adjustments

⚠️ A modern browser (Chrome, Firefox, Edge) is recommended for best results
